# IaC Security Weakness: AWS CMK Key Rotation Not Enabled

## Weakness Overview
AWS KMS Customer Master Keys (CMK) should have automatic key rotation enabled to reduce the risk of key compromise and meet compliance requirements.

---

## Detection Criteria

### Core Conditions to Flag
| Condition | Risk |
|-----------|------|
| Key rotation **explicitly disabled** | High |
| Key rotation **not defined** (missing field) | High |
| Key is **enabled** but rotation is **false/absent** | High |

---

## Keywords & Attributes to Detect

### Resource Identifiers
```
kms_key
aws_kms_key
kms
customer_master_key
cmk
```

### Critical Attributes/Fields
```
enable_key_rotation     ← primary field to inspect
key_rotation_enabled
rotation_enabled
is_enabled / enabled    ← key state (must correlate with rotation)
key_state
deletion_window_in_days ← indicates an active/managed key
```

### Dangerous Value Patterns
```
enable_key_rotation = false
enable_key_rotation = "false"
enable_key_rotation → absent/null/undefined
enabled = true  +  enable_key_rotation = false  ← critical combination
```

---

## Detection Logic (Pseudo-conditions)

```
IF resource_type == KMS_KEY
  AND (key is enabled OR enabled is not explicitly false)
  AND (
       enable_key_rotation == false
       OR enable_key_rotation is missing
      )
THEN → FLAG as VULNERABLE
```

---

## Related Compliance Frameworks
- **CIS AWS Foundations** – 3.7
- **AWS Security Hub** – KMS.4
- **PCI-DSS** – Requirement 3.6
- **NIST 800-53** – SC-12

package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

is_kms_resource(node) {
    regex.match("(?i).*(kms_key|kms|customer_master_key|cmk).*", node.type)
}

is_explicitly_disabled(node) {
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(node)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == "enabled"
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == false
}

has_rotation_attribute(node) {
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(node)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == "enable_key_rotation"
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    atomic_units := glitch_lib.all_atomic_units(parent)
    node := atomic_units[_]

    is_kms_resource(node)
    not is_explicitly_disabled(node)

    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(node)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == "enable_key_rotation"
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == false

    result := {
        "type": "sec_aws_cmk_rotation_disabled",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "KMS CMK key rotation not enabled - Customer Master Keys should have automatic key rotation enabled to reduce the risk of key compromise. (CWE-321)"
    }
}
